chunks: Jamil narrated from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
Flour in exchange for wheat, and parched flour in exchange for flour, equal for equal, there is no harm in it.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to exchange flour for wheat or parched flour for flour in equal measure?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on exchange involving wheat, flour, and parched flour. It permits such exchange when it is conducted in equal measure, indicating a fiqh ruling related to riba and lawful commercial exchange.
